review: Read the complete hosted interpreter status panel and its six tests. The only public-preview delta adds three_person_voice to the accepted capacityProfile type; runtime evaluation remains restricted to three_human_text.

First-party React/TypeScript with synthetic UUID rooms, example.test authority and mocked native/HTTP boundaries. No keys, private profiles, transcripts, third-party implementation or game assets exported.

Status refresh checks the exact room and session room, discards stale request epochs and aborts on room/account changes. Native key selection and interpreter preparation require explicit owner controls. A configured key is explicitly distinguished from active shared AI or successful provider access.

The two-turn evaluation control checks owner, exact configured session/generation, initial one-turn ceiling and text-only profile. It sends an explicit reviewed operation; this panel does not dispatch a model turn.

Existing tests cover wrong-room rejection, late account response, guest read-only UI, owner preparation/key selection, configured-state language and exact evaluation generation. Shared schemas and server/native enforcement remain separate dependencies.
limits: Unpublished unfrozen source proposal; type-only delta already included in private R380, not a new implementation.
Six existing mocked tests do not establish three-person voice operation, paid provider access, installed room consent or game/GPT Live continuity.

Owner mutations use revision checks for visible results but cannot cancel an already admitted native/server operation. Busy-state completion across account/room switches has no regression coverage in this existing suite; do not claim complete mutation-lifecycle qualification.
No backend admission, funding or runtime authority changed by this export.
